description: Take-home pay in Australia for a salary or hourly rate, for 2025-26 or 2026-27. Returns gross pay, PAYG tax withheld, net pay and the employer's 12% super for each week, fortnight and month and for the year, plus a basic estimate of the year's tax and refund that assumes no other income and uses the $1,000 standard deduction for work expenses (from 2026-27). Use it for questions like 'how much do I take home on $85,000'. For one specific pay with declaration details use payg_withholding; for a tax return estimate with deductions, other income, family or seniors offsets use annual_tax_estimate; to go from a target take-home to a salary use salary_for_take_home. Amounts in AUD. Read-only and deterministic; no network calls.

foreignResident.description: Foreign resident for tax purposes. Default false.

hourlyRate.description: Hourly rate in AUD excluding super, including any casual loading, e.g. 35.5.

hoursPerWeek.description: Hours a week for hourlyRate. Default 38 (full time).

salary.description: Annual salary in AUD, excluding super unless salaryIncludesSuper is true, e.g. 85000. Give salary or hourlyRate, not both.

salaryIncludesSuper.description: The salary is a total package that includes the 12% super guarantee. Default false.

studyLoan.description: Has a HELP, VSL, SSL or other study and training support loan. Default false.

taxFreeThreshold.description: Tax-free threshold claimed with this employer. Default true (main job). Use false for a second job.

taxYear.description: Australian financial year (1 July to 30 June) whose withholding tables to use. Default 2026-27.

tfnProvided.description: Employee gave their tax file number. Default true. False applies the no-TFN rate.

title: Australian take-home pay
